steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants screen where surrogate bidding is available.
Reach the Participants list and its vendor Add Bid controls.
Open the surrogate-bid drawer for the eligible vendor.
Verify Submit Bid is disabled before any price is entered.
Enter one valid price in the bid drawer.
Verify the price registered and Submit Bid is now enabled.
